            "from String",
            "from String",
            "from String",
            "from String",
            "from String",

            "from String",

        final Object[] input = {
            String.valueOf(Long.MIN_VALUE),
            "-17",
            "-1",
            "0",
            "1",
            "17",
            String.valueOf(Long.MAX_VALUE),
            new Byte((byte)7),
            new Short((short)8),

            new Float(11.1),
            new Double(12.2)
        };

            BigInteger.valueOf(9),
            BigInteger.valueOf(10),
            BigInteger.valueOf(11),
